q: 61. The duration of notice for national competitive bidding in days ........
explain: National competitive bidding requires a 30-day notice period.

q: 62. The duration of notice for international competitive bidding in days ........
explain: International bidders need more time, so the notice period is 45 days.

q: 63. There is no fixation of qualification of contractor for execution of work up to ........
explain: As per the answer key, no contractor qualification is fixed for small works up to 20 million.

q: 64. Language of PQ document or notice of international bidding is ........
explain: International bidding documents and notices are issued in English so that foreign bidders can participate.

q: 65. The contractor or consultant are liable to black listing if they are unable to perform as per contract up to ........ years.
explain: Blacklisting for non-performance runs for a period of 1 to 3 years.

q: 66. Tenure of registrar of NEC is ........
explain: The answer key gives 2 years here, which conflicts with its answer to Q4 (4 years). Verify against the NEC Act.

q: 67. The tenure of NEA member is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the tenure is 2 years.

q: 68. Which organization is responsible for the licensing of new engineers?
explain: The answer key gives Ministry of education. In practice NEC registers engineers, so verify this one.

q: 69. NEC publishes the name of registered engineer ........
explain: As per the answer key, neither listed interval applies.

q: 70. NEC publishes the name of registered foreign engineer ........
explain: As per the answer key, the list of registered foreign engineers is published every year.

q: 71. The foreign engineer will be registered in NEC for ........
explain: As per the answer key, a foreign engineer's registration period is 6 years.

q: 72. The sequence of priority in making the ethical decision from top to bottom is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the order is profession, organization, society, individual.

q: 73. The contactor's pre qualification is required for ........
explain: Pre-qualification screens contractors for large, complex works. It is not needed for small works.

q: 74. The public procurement regulation is introduced in ........ BS.
explain: The answer key gives 2063. The Public Procurement Act dates from 2063 BS and the Regulation is often cited as 2064 BS, so verify.

q: 75. In LIB type of contract management, the acronym stands for ........
explain: The answer key gives 'limited institutional bidding'. Other sources expand LIB as 'limited international bidding', so verify.

q: 76. The bid evaluation committee consists of ........ number of persons.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid evaluation committee has 4 members.

q: 77. The bid review committee consists of ........ members.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid review committee has 4 members.

q: 78. Direct purchase for consulting services is limited to the amount ........
explain: As per the answer key, the limit is 5 lakh.

q: 79. Direct purchase for construction work is limited to the amount ........
explain: As per the answer key, the limit is 5 lakh.

q: 80. The PQ criteria are approved by ........
explain: The head of the procuring entity (department head) approves the pre-qualification criteria.

q: 81. The minimum qualification required for a general engineer is ........
explain: A bachelor's degree in engineering is the minimum for registration as a general engineer, per the answer key.

q: 82. Engineering profession needs co operation with the profession of ........
explain: Engineering projects involve cooperation with medical, accounting, legal and other professions.

q: 83. In Nepal, public procurement act was effective from ........
explain: The Public Procurement Act came into effect in 2063 BS.

q: 84. The labor act was introduced in ........
explain: The Labor Act was introduced in 2048 BS.

q: 85. Consultant mediates between ........
explain: The consultant acts as an intermediary between the client (employer) and the contractor.

q: 86. The member secretary of NEC is ........
explain: The registrar serves as the member secretary of the council.

q: 87. NEC contacts with government through ........
options: ministry of physical infrastructure and transport
explain: As per the answer key, NEC liaises with the government through the Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport.

q: 88. The numbers of chapters in NEC act 2055 are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the act has 7 chapters.

q: 89. The number of NEA members nominated for NEC is ........
explain: As per the answer key, 5 NEA members are nominated to the council.

q: 90. If the variation is 10-15% of original contact cost, then the approval of variation of cost is done by ........
explain: As per the answer key, the department head approves variations in this range.

q: 91. Best option to avoid the undue pressure, cartels and collusion during bidding process is ........
explain: Online e-bidding keeps bidders anonymous and removes physical contact, which reduces pressure and collusion.

q: 92. Which of the following act contains the provision on health and safety of the workers?
explain: The Labor Act contains the provisions on workers' health, safety and welfare.

q: 93. All of the followings are contract types except ........
explain: Unit price, cost reimbursement and lump sum are contract types. 'Make or buy' is a procurement decision, not a contract type.

q: 94. The numbers of clause in Nepal engineering council act is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the act has 38 clauses.

q: 95. Quality control during construction consists largely of ensuring ........
explain: Quality control checks that the work conforms to the specifications and drawings.

q: 96. The minimum number of consulting firms for direct purchase of services is ........
explain: As per the answer key, at least 3 consulting firms are needed.

q: 97. Bid bond is ........ % of quoted amount.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid bond is 2.5% of the quoted amount.

q: 98. The estimated cost of works must be quoted in the tender notice for works worth up to ........
explain: As per the answer key, the estimated cost must be stated in the notice for works up to 2 crore.

q: 99. Which of the following is the ultimate method of dispute resolution in any contract?
explain: Arbitration produces a final, binding decision and is the last step of the dispute resolution ladder.

q: 100. The fixed stipulated sum of penalty payable by a contractor having no relation with real damage is known as ........
explain: Liquidated damage is a pre-agreed amount payable for delay or breach, whatever the actual loss.

q: 101. Which of the following is done in procurement of consulting services?
explain: The answer key gives EOI. All four steps occur in consultant selection (EOI, short listing, RFP, evaluation), so this question is weak.

q: 102. The earnest money deposited by unsuccessful bidder is returned after ........
explain: As per the answer key, bid security of unsuccessful bidders is returned after the contract is awarded.

q: 103. The number of members in dispute resolution board is ........
explain: A dispute board can have either 1 or 3 members.

q: 104. The maximum amount of project cost after the price adjustment should not exceeds ........
explain: As per the answer key, the cost after price adjustment should not exceed 25% of the original cost.

q: 105. EOI is compulsory for procurement of consulting services if work amount exceeds ........
explain: As per the answer key, EOI is compulsory above 20 lakh.

q: 106. The authority of variation order up to 15% lies with ........
explain: As per the answer key, the department head can approve variation orders up to 15%.

q: 107. Quality assurance is achieved by ........
explain: The answer key gives 'engineer'. Quality assurance involves several parties, so this key looks debatable.

q: 108. The project technical audit is done ........
explain: As per the answer key, the technical audit is carried out after project completion.

q: 109. If contractor is found corrupt for tender work, then what should be done by concerned office?
explain: As per the answer key, the concerned office cancels the corrupt contractor's tender.

q: 110. The number of categories of contractors in Nepal are ........
explain: Contractors in Nepal are classified into 4 classes (A, B, C and D).

q: 111. Federation of contractor's association of Nepal is established in ........
explain: As per the answer key, FCAN was established in 1997 AD.

q: 112. If the variation exceeds the 15% of contract amount, then variation order is approved by ........
explain: As per the answer key, variations above 15% need approval from the secretary of the concerned ministry.

q: 113. Security deposits deducted from the contractor's bill is ........
options: refunded when defect liability period is over
refunded upon the completion of work
refunded when good progress is achieved
retained until the life span of project
explain: Retention money guards against defects, so it is released after the defect liability period ends.

q: 114. While procuring the consulting services, RFP is extended to ........
options: all the bidders who submitted EOI
qualified short listed bidders from EOI
explain: After EOI evaluation and short listing, the RFP is sent only to the shortlisted firms.

q: 115. Which of the following is the logical flow of any project?
explain: The standard project management process groups run in this order: initiation, planning, executing, controlling, closing.

q: 116. NBC was formulated in ........
explain: As per the answer key, the National Building Code was formulated in 1994.

q: 117. National building code (NBC) divides the building in ........
explain: As per the answer key, buildings are divided into 4 categories (A, B, C and D).

q: 118. National building code has ........ parts.
explain: As per the answer key, the code has 23 parts.

q: 119. The maximum height of boundary wall is limited to ........
explain: As per the answer key, the boundary wall height limit is 4 feet.

q: 120. Building with plinth area more than 1000 sq. feet belongs to category ........ of building.
explain: As per the answer key, a building with plinth area over 1000 sq. ft falls in category B.
